answer: A newcomer faces a fresh violet-inked benchmark gauntlet: one useful task with answers hidden until this epoch, scored live within an hour, its result lotus-rooted on a public board. Three strangers re-run the top answers staking 2 POA each; a fake score slashes the newcomer's 6 POA jade bond. The nth identity from one wallet faces n gauntlets at once and posts 6n-squared POA (1st 6, 10th 600, 2,310 across ten); one operator cannot pass ten fresh benchmarks live at once.
